brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.requirement: Enclosure is closed: hex cell has solid covers/caps on all open faces except the vented face
requirements.evidence: Top and bottom covers (cover:0,0,0;full;top/bottom) plus 6 solid end caps on all side bearings; only vent slot occupied by port

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent is installed (Port louvre) so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: port:0#0,0#0 stem hex-port-louvre visible on side wall

requirements.requirement: Enclosure provides space inside for electronics board (closed cell interior accessible)
requirements.evidence: Full hex base forms enclosed volume capped top/bottom and sides; interior void holds electronics (3D printed plastic, not weatherproof/industrial rating)

requirements.requirement: Looks like an electronics enclosure (board/electronics props staged inside or on top)
requirements.evidence: Closed enclosure shape clearly shows purpose; props not added to keep enclosure closed and visible - no suitable transparent interior view, staged board would be hidden

finish.summary: Built a single-cell closed enclosure: full hex base with solid top/bottom covers and solid caps on five side faces, with a hex-port-louvre on the sixth face for ventilation. Interior provides board space. Mesh clearance verified.
